input.quote: 15.16 Nonsolicitation. During the Term and for a period of [***] thereafter, neither Party shall solicit an employee of the other Party who is or has been involved in the performance or oversight of any of the development activities hereunder to terminate his or her employment and accept employment or work as a consultant with the soliciting Party. Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing herein shall restrict or preclude the Parties' right to make generalized searches for employees by way of a general solicitation for employment placed in a trade journal, newspaper or website.
input.rationale: Section 15.16 is the only non-solicitation provision in the agreement. It is already mutual, limited to employees involved in the development activities, solicitation-only (no no-hire), and carries a general-advertising carve-out. It fails the fallback on two material terms: the duration runs for the whole Term plus an undisclosed ([***]) tail measured from expiry rather than 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement, and there is no unsolicited-approach carve-out. We therefore target the fallback with two surgical edits and leave the mutual scope and existing carve-out wording untouched.

ops.oldText: During the Term and for a period of [***] thereafter, neither Party
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after an employee's involvement in the development activities hereunder ends, neither Party

ops.oldText: nothing herein shall restrict or preclude the Parties' right to make generalized searches for employees by way of a general solicitation for employment placed in a trade journal, newspaper or website.
ops.newText: nothing herein shall restrict or preclude the Parties' right to make generalized searches for employees by way of a general solicitation for employment placed in a trade journal, newspaper or website, or to respond to any employee who approaches a Party on an unsolicited basis.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We capped the non-solicit at twelve months measured from the end of the individual's involvement (replacing the Term-plus-undisclosed tail) and added the customary unsolicited-approach carve-out alongside the existing general-advertising carve-out. The clause otherwise remains mutual, limited to involved personnel and solicitation-only.
proposal.summary: Cap the non-solicit at 12 months from the end of the employee's involvement and add an unsolicited-approach carve-out.
